what_it_is: Ecosystem of robotic navigation: ExcelsiusGPS (robotic guidance), Excelsius3D (intraop imaging), ExcelsiusHub (data). NVM5 neuromonitoring integrates nerve avoidance, monitoring, computer-assisted rod bending, angular assessment.
indications: Spine surgery navigation and robotic guidance.
compatible_with: CREO and Reline fixation. NVM5 neuromonitoring. Bendini rod bending.
